messages.body:

Surprising news! I’m puzzled about this “Supreme Victorious” UN UK Treasure award in Pound Sterlings. How was I picked as the first winner?

Please verify:
- Your full name (you left “add ur name here”).
- Are you UN UK Treasury or UK UN Banking? How’s LAGO MAGGIORE ITALIA LTD at Piazza Guiseppe Garibaldo involved?
- Exact amount and step-by-step.

Do I put ACCEPT in the subject or body, and is it ALL CAPS? I mix that up.

I won’t send personal details by email. Kindly mail an official letter on headed paper to my local post office for in-person pickup. No links or attachments.

What time zone are you—Italy Greenwich? I’m Mountain… I think. Sir Peppers says “Don’t click!

Best wishes,
Eleanor

messages.subject: Re: Congratulations on winning the award
messages.body:
Hello Eleanor,

I hope this email finds you well, your name appeared after the conference
held in Seville, Spain, from June 30 to July 3, 2025. The conference
brought together global leaders, international organizations, and other
stakeholders to address challenges in financing the Sustainable Development
Goals (SDGs), reform the international financial architecture, and foster
greater international cooperation. Key outcomes included the Seville
Commitment, which proposes new solutions for global debt, that grant your
award from the UN/UK Treasury Department. The Participants: Included
government leaders, representatives from international organizations,
financial institutions, businesses, and civil society.

I am working with the UN appointed for your award beneficiary
representative. I will need your details such as full names, e.t.c.  in
other to proceed
Best Regards,
Ladan

You wrote about a Saville (Seville?) conference “June to July.” Which exact dates and which year/time zone? Who chaired it, and what’s the reference number for my file?

Please mail a letter on official letterhead to my local post office for pickup. No links. Include a publicly listed callback number I can verify myself.

Also, list—step by slow step—what info you need and why, and where it’s stored. I won’t send personal details by email.

Thank you kindly. Sir Peppers is squawking “UN-UK!” which I think means hurry, but we’re not rushing.

messages.body:
Dear Client

There's a certain fixed deposit that was made in 2006, the duration of the
fixed deposit have long expired and your name and email was mentioned by
the depositor as a beneficiary.

Our bank's previous head of account operations Mr Paul Mendez partly
processed the claim but didn't conclude the process before his retirement.

As the current head of account operations I came across the inconclusive
transaction in our review of all unclaimed deposits.

See attached file for the fixed deposit when it was first deposited by an
Indonesia woman and the interest it has accumulated as at 2023.

There are 3 options available for you, which are listed below for you to
make a suitable choice


OPTION 1, Denunciation of claim, in a legal context, this refers to
publicly rejecting the claim, with the aim of discrediting it or
demonstrating its invalidity. It can also involve formally rejecting or
renouncing the claim. This action can be seen as a form of public censure
or condemnation, this will legally protect our bank from any legal action
related to the claims in the future by yourself or your legal
representative. Once this option is taken, the bank will be at liberty to
confiscate the fund for whatever purpose the bank deem fit.

OPTION 2, Completion of the transaction , This option involves the
provision of the method chosen by you for the conclusion of the
transaction. Some will choose to open an account with our bank, some choose
to transfer the fund to their country or place of residence.

OPTION 3  Relinquishment of fund, This is the act of giving up or
surrendering something, like a right, responsibility, or possession. It can
involve the voluntary release of a claim, interest, or power, allowing
another party to assume those rights or responsibilities.

Please reply with an option of your choice to avoid future disturbance by
the bank as regards to this transaction. Thanks for your anticipated
cooperation/

Sincerely Yours
Dr Gonzalo Gortarzar
Head of Operations
Caixa Bank Madrid Spain

messages.subject: Re: HELLO AGAIN' FROM IVONNE De BAKI
messages.body:
My dear friend Julie,

I thank you for responding back to my last email to you.
But from the tone of your response, I can deduce that you did not receive
the email proposal that I previously sent to you.
So I am hereby resending it to you.
As an introduction once again, I am Ivonne Juez Abuchacra De Baki, Ecuador
Ambassador to FRANCE.

You can read more about me from the link below.

But you can ignore the links and just read the below email message.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ivonne_Baki

I am soliciting your consent for a business partnership.
I wanted to send you some pictures but you instructed no attachments.

At the last auditing of all accounts under my care (as the former
ambassador to the US), by independent auditors, I uncovered an over
inflated taxes paid by some contractors which amounts to USD18,075,000.00
{18 milion} hidden in an escrow account belonging to my organization in one
of the very big banks. The discovery came to me as a shock because the head
of accounts before his unfortunate death from #COVID-19 was directed to
deactivate and discontinue most of the accounts so as to narrow down to
just a few for easier access and accountability. So it came to me as a
surprise when the independent auditors I hired found out payments were made
to that particular account from 2018 till present as it was still
functional. The good news is that the details have been handed back to me
and the existence of this account with US$18,075,000.00 is known by me
alone. The origin of these said funds are pay backs the contractors send to
me as thank you for signing our contacts papers and also some of the funds
came from the inflated taxes invoices sent to the contractors which the tax
funds has already been sent to the Ecuador government account. The rest of
the $18,075,000.00 and more are sincerely mine.

As the chief executive and first person then as the Ambassador to the US in
charge of all affairs and funds, I can authorize the transfer of these
funds to your bank account within fourteen (14) working days if you will
partner with me. I have a very handsome reward and compensation plan of 35%
in mind for you if you will work with me. How you will handle the rest 65%,
I will explain in my next email as soon as you have responded back to me
accepting my 35% offer as your share.

To avoid any delay in the transfer process, the bank will delegate an
immediate transfer of the fund to your designated bank account by wire
transfer. If you are interested, then get back to me ASAP, as I hope to
hear from you today.
Best regards,
Her Excellency,
Ivonne Juez Abuchacra de Baki
The Ecuador Ambassador to France
.


*

What’s your office postal address, and which bank holds the funds?
Kettle’s on and Sir Biscuit keeps mimicking the phone, so apologies if I’m slow. Thanks for your patience. Would a mailed letter be possible?

Best wishes,
Julie

messages.body:
My dearest Julie,

I thank you very much for getting back to me again!
I thank you also, for your willingness to work/partner with me.

With the position that I have held, mostly as the former ambassador to the
United States, and now currently as the ambassador to France, I will never
want to soil my hands with illegalities. I assure you that this project is
100% legal, authentic and risk free. Those are funds earned legitimately
from contractors "thank you" to me. There will not be any single problems
in the claim process or obstacles to get the funds to your designated
account. You have nothing to worry about as everything has been put in
place for a successful fund transfer to your designated bank account. All
details and information that I may provide for you during the course of
this claim, you can take your time to verify them behind my back even
without telling me. Every document of claims you received to back  the
claim of this fund in the course of the fund transfer to you, please take
time to call the agencies to have them verified. I hold such a high
position in society to get involved in anything that is illegal.
.
As you were informed in my former email to you, this is a 100% legitimate
transaction!
The source of the fund is from over-inflated taxes on oil and gas
contractors. Over-inflated taxing is a normal occurrence from time to time,
when dealing with companies especially in the Oil and Gas sector that are
fond of evading taxes. It is a way for us to raise funds and cover up for
the contractors' years of evading paying taxes albeit inflated. It only
happened to be that the account they have paid this money to, has not been
accessed for a long time till the auditors came in. This transaction is
100% safe, risk free and the fund is legitimate sources. The over inflated
funds on the taxes paid has been separated from that which belongs to my
organization. What is left now is what was inflated on the actual taxes.
The $18,075,000.00 which was inflated on the actual funds is 100% mine
being paid by the contractors to me.

I want to present your name and company details to the bank as the
beneficiary/contractor awaiting to be paid this $18,075,000.00 so that it
can be released to your designated bank account by my consent and my letter
of authorization. I will also provide you with all the diplomatic powers
and political backing that my office provides that will back up the move of
such huge funds to you without any form of wire transfer obstacles or
financial laws of your country hindering you from receiving the transfer
till the fund is successfully transferred to you. It will come into your
account as contract funds that you worked for and earned as a contractor to
my office, which is the Ecuador Embassy in the United States. All I ask for
is absolute confidentiality, honesty and trust.

With my position, I have made friends and connections in Banks/ government
offices. They act as my insider agents in high places to render help at any
time. Currently, my insider agents in the Tender Board Committee in charge
of Contract Awards and Payment Approvals have already provided me with all
that is required for the smooth flow of this transaction, and sent payment
memos to the bank. All that they await therefore, is for me to send in the
name and details of a beneficiary/contractor so that they will commence the
payment and award you a legitimate "Contractors Job Completion
Certificates''.

I desire therefore that we work this out with an open and honest mind. The
money belongs to me as explained. I am making you the owner with legal
documents to back it up and provide you with all the legal documents that
will make you a 100% legitimate owner of the fund/ contractor to my embassy
to receive this huge fund. You have absolutely nothing to worry about for I
have it all under control to make sure the fund is successfully transferred
to your designated account in the next 14 working days. I have previously
stated the sharing formula is my earlier email to you and I am glad you are
very okay with what was offered.

messages.body:
Dear winner,



My name is William Henry Gates. I am an American businessman, investor, philanthropist, and co-founder of Microsoft Corporation. All my life, I have believed in the principle of giving. One thought has always stayed with me: wealth should be used to help others. For this reason, I have decided to donate €2,000,000 (two million euros) to randomly selected individuals from around the world. Your email address was selected through a random search, and you are one of the fortunate recipients of this philanthropic donation. If you are receiving this message, please consider it a genuine opportunity.



Please contact me soon so I can make sure your email address is correct. You can Google my name for more information: (William Henry Gates).



Congratulations again and thank you for being part of a better future.



I look forward to your reply.



Best regards

Mr. William H. Gates

Philanthropist and founder of the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation

Best wishes,

grants. This donation is meant to help you improve your personal

Dearly Beloved In Christ,



I bring peace and love to you from God and our Lord Jesus Christ. It is by the grace of God that I received Christ, having known the truth, I had no choice than to do what is lawful and right in the sight of God for eternal life and in the sight of man to witness God's mercy and glory upon my life.



I am Mrs. Abigail Perez Alejandro, the wife of Mr. Alberto Antonio Alejandro from the Philippines, My husband worked with the Central Bank of the Philippines for ten years before he died in 2012. We were married for twenty-seven years without a child. My Husband died after a brief illness that lasted for only ten days. Before his death we were both born again Christians.



Since his death I decided not to re-marry or get a child outside my matrimonial home which the Bible is against. When my late husband was alive he deposited the sum of $8,200,000.00 USD (Eight Million Two Hundred Thousand American Dollars) with the Bay Federal Credit Union Bank in Georgia, United States of America. Presently, this money is still with the bank and the management just wrote me as the Next of Kin to come forward to sign for the release of this fund only known to me and my late husband or rather issue an authorization to somebody to receive it on my behalf if I cannot come over.




Unfortunately, I'm in a hospital in the Philippines where I have been undergoing treatment for esophageal cancer.
 I have since lost my ability to talk and my doctors have told me that I have only a few months to live. It is my last wish to see this money distributed to charitable organizations anywhere in the World. Because relatives and friends have plundered so much of my wealth since my illness, I cannot live with the agony of entrusting this huge responsibility to any of them.



Please, I beg you in the name of God to help me stand and collect the money from the Bay Federal Credit Union Bank. I want a person that is God fearing that will use this money to fund churches, orphanages and widows propagating the word of God and to ensure that the house of God is maintained. The Bible made us understand that blessed is the hand that gives. I took this decision because I don't have any child that will inherit this money and my husband's relatives are not Christians and I don't want my husband's hard earned money to be misused by unbelievers.



I don't want a situation where this money will be used in an ungodly manner. Hence the reason for taking this bold decision. I am not afraid of death hence I know where I am going. I know that I am going to be in the bosom of the Lord. Exodus 14 VS 14 says that the lord will fight my case and I shall hold my peace. I don't need any telephone communication in this regard because of my soundless voice and presence of my husband's relatives around me always. I don't want them to know about this development. With God all things are possible.



As soon as I receive your response I shall give you the contact information of my late husband's attorney in the United States of America as he will be the one to assist you in laying claims for this money.



Best regards,

Yours in Christ,



Mrs. Abigail Perez Alejandro.

In light of this unfortunate event, the IMF has initiated a compensation program to assist individuals who have been affected by such fraudulent activities through citibank plc.



I am pleased to inform you that you are eligible for compensation in the amount of $5,500,000.00 (Five Million Five Hundred Thousand United States Dollars). This compensation is intended to help alleviate the financial burden you may have experienced as a result of the scam. Please note that this compensation is being provided by the IMF as a goodwill gesture and is not meant to replace any losses you may have incurred.



In order to facilitate the disbursement of the compensation funds to you, we kindly request that you provide us with the necessary information to verify your identity. This may include personal details such as your full name, address, phone number, and a valid form of identification. Rest assured that all information provided will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of verifying your eligibility for compensation.



To achieve this, we recommend that you accept the following terms and conditions of payment below:

2. You must agree with us that said fees mentioned cannot be deducted from the said amount and be rest assured that after the payment of the account opening deposit of $100 there will be no up front payment until the total amount of $5,500,000.00 in your online account is successfully transferred.

Once the account opening deposit of $100 is received we shall open a checking or Savings online bank account in your name with citibank plc and the sum of $5,500,000.00 will be credited into your online account.



You will also be given your login details so you can access your online bank account and make personal online money transfers to your chosen bank account



I understand that this may come as unexpected news, but please know that the IMF is committed to assisting individuals who have fallen victim to financial scams. We believe that by providing this compensation, we can help restore some peace of mind and financial stability to those who have been affected.



If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me directly at [
[email protected]
]. I am here to assist you every step of the way and ensure that the process runs smoothly.



Thank you for your attention to this important matter. We look forward to hearing from you and helping you receive the compensation you are entitled to.



Warm regards,



Nicolas Castro

messages.subject: Re: CRUDE OIL BUSINESS INVESTMENT
messages.body:
Dear James

Thank you for your well received message.  Your reply I believe is an
indication that you are willing to be part of this business opportunity.
Also this will not prevent you from doing your normal business as this
project is on the side for making extra income as a legal crude oil license
holder/sales agent. As long as you are going to be sincere towards this
project, we will have reasons to celebrate in the end. The business is
completely legal and you have nothing to worry about and as an
international business man you know the process and requirements to acquire
a lifting license in a crude oil business.

PLEASE READ THE DETAILS AND GET BACK TO ME

You are to become a middleman/sales agent between the buyer and the
National Oil Corporation of Libya (NOC). You will be corresponding between
the NOC (seller) and (buyer) electronically from the comfort of your home.
To set the ball rolling in this venture, the first step is for us to apply
for the crude oil export and marketing license from the NOC.

There are two ways through which you can apply for the license, one you can
apply in your company name if you have a registered company or you can
apply as an individual in your name. I will draft a license application
letter for you to fill and send to the Licensing operations department of
the NOC to apply for the license.

You will type the license application letter into your official company
letterhead paper (If you want to apply in your company name) and send the
application directly to the licensing operations department of  NOC which
is responsible for issuing crude oil sales licenses. I will direct you step
by step from the process of acquiring the license to become the middleman
to the process of selling your allocated product to the BUYER.

I will link you up with one company which has intentions to buy 2 million
barrels of Libyan crude on monthly bases for 1 year. (So the commissions
are paid out every month throughout the duration of the 12month
contract.)This implies that you will not have problems finding buyers.

I will guide you to apply for the license and also guide you step by step
in all your correspondence between NOC and the BUYER until the BUYER pays
the NOC for the crude after which your commissions will be calculated and
paid into your nominated receiving bank account.

Getting this license will give you the legal authorization of the NOC to
become their sales agent. Please be informed that getting this license is
never a walk in the park because of the prospective nature of the
commissions paid to license owners every month.

The licenses are usually given to the families and relatives of the top
government officials as they did not want people to benefit from such a
lucrative venture. But I have someone in the ministry of oil and gas who
will assist us in getting the license. I will guide you to apply for this
license and once you obtain it, the new doors will open.



So I will need you to confirm if you want to apply for the license in your
company name or in your individual name though company name is preferable.

Awaiting your reply to enable us to move towards applying for the license.
Regards
sanni ibrahim

messages.subject: Nice To Meet You Today
messages.body:
Nice To Meet You Today



I write to you with a language translator. I have been in search of someone with this last name, Heghea. so when I saw your profile on Facebook I decided to add you and write to you this message to see how best we can assist each other. I am Mrs. Füsun Gültekin, a Bank Officer here in Istanbul Turkey with COMMERCIAL BANKING COMPANY, TURKIYE ISBANK. I believe it is the wish of God for me to come across you now. I am having an important business discussion I wish to share with you which I believe will interest you because it is in connection with your last name/nationality and you are going to benefit from it.



One late Mr. Allen Heghea, a citizen of your country who was in the Coal business and he deals on electricity production here in Turkey had a fixed deposit with my bank in 2012 for 108 calendar months, valued at US$22,500,000.00 (Twenty-Two Million, Five Hundred United State Dollars) the due date for this deposit was last year. Sadly Allen Heghea, was among the death victims in the recent 2019-2020 Corona Virus ( Covid 19 ) pandemic outbreak here in Turkey while he was on a business trip



My bank management is yet to know about his death, I knew about this because I was his account officer. He did not mention any Next of Kin/Heir when the account was opened, and he was not married and no relative was found. Last week my Bank Management had a meeting for a bank verification exercise to note dormant and abandoned deposit accounts. I know this will happen and that is why I have been looking for a means to handle the situation because if my Bank Directors happen to discover his death, The bank will divert the funds for their head directors to share. So I don't want such to happen. That was why when I saw your details, I was happy.



I am now seeking your cooperation to present you as Next of Kin/ Heir to the account since you have the same last name and same nationality with him and my bank headquarters will release the account to you through my help. There is no risk involved; the transaction will be executed under a legitimate arrangement that will protect you from any breach of law. It is better that we claim the money than allowing the Bank Directors to divert it and share among themselves. I am not a greedy person, so I am suggesting we share the funds, 50/50% for you and I respectively. Let me know your mind on this and please do treat this information confidential.



Forward your Current address listed Below:

Your full names: _______

Your Country: ___________

Date of birth: _________

A copy of your passport or driving license:

Occupation: ________

Current address: _____

Phone number: ______



Once I receive the above mentioned information and conclude my internal arrangements and changes in our bank database. I shall give you more details once I receive your urgent response through my personal email address below.



My cell phone +1 330 267 7578 and WhatsApp +1 240 851 5051

Email: 
[email protected]

Best regards,

Mrs. Fusun Gultekin

I completely understand your concern, and I’m happy to clarify this for you. *Base Wallet* is the decentralized version of Coinbase, while the *Coinbase Exchange Wallet* is centralized.

Because of the nature of your funds, they must first be received in a *decentralized wallet* (such as Base). Once received, you are free to transfer them to any other wallet of your choice.

To put it simply:

*Decentralized Wallets (like Base):* You control your own private keys and have full ownership of your funds. No third party can restrict your access.
* *Centralized Wallets (like Coinbase Exchange):* The platform controls the private keys on your behalf, meaning your funds are managed by the exchange, not directly by you.

So, while both are associated with Coinbase, *Base Wallet is decentralized and gives you full control*, whereas the *Coinbase Exchange Wallet is centralized and works more like a traditional exchange account.*

Demola Aderemi..

Your involvement would not only honor a dying wish but also spark a wave of goodwill and positive change in the lives of many. Together, we can bring light where there is darkness and hope where it is needed most.

messages.body:
Hello Nicolas ,

Thank you for your quick response and the willingness to embark on
this transaction.

Like I wrote to you in my first email, this is a request to engage you
and your company to assist us in completing a business project. It
involves using you/company for a classified transfer of funds out of
China where the $950,500,000.00 is at the moment and to re-deposit and
invest it in your country.

The key information about the funds is as follows:

1)      Value of Funds      : $950,500,000.00.
2)      Holding Bank          : www.icbc-ltd.com
3)      Signatory                : Held in Blind Trust.
4)      Source of Funds     : Good and Clean (ICBC Bank Certified).
5)      Your Commission   : 7% on the total amount and 2% as holding commission.

Before we proceed further, it is very important I do take time out to
explain everything about the situation so that you will have a much
clearer and a great deal of better understanding of the project and
what it involves. I want to be as honest, open and sincere as possible
in my disclosure of the whole story to you. So please take your time
to read and understand the following points carefully so you can
appreciate why we need your help and how we can work together to
accomplish our project.


1. Mrs. Diezani Alison-Madueke, who is the Ex-Minister of Petroleum
and an Ex-OPEC President.

However, the current government in her country is confiscating most of
her financial estate due to personal vendetta. The government is
seizing everything she has worked for in over 20 years along with her
husband’s assets. This I believe is wrong, inhuman and unjust and it
is the very reason why I have accepted her challenge to help her
relocate the only remaining life savings of $950,500,000.00
immediately out of China to take care of herself and her siblings for
the rest of their lives.

2.       With the above well said and understood by you, it is
important you appreciate that the first and most critical stage of the
project is to move the funds out of China/Hong Kong under your profile
and identity. So, the plan is we must concentrate all our efforts to
move the money out of China/Hong Kong as a priority and as soon as
possible within the next 1-2 weeks’ time. The reinvestment
stage/project comes after the funds are confirmed received by you.


The funds in question are currently deposited in the name of an
existing legal entity who is acting as a “”Blind Trust”” holding
custodian ownership. This project therefore is to change the ownership
particulars of the $950,000,000.00 into a new identity (your
identity/profile) so that it cannot be traced back to Mrs. Diezani
Alison-Madueke.


To ensure the safety of everyone involved in this project, we will use
only the legal procedures and legitimate documentation required by
China/Hong Kong Banking laws to present you as the original “”ultimate
beneficial owner”” or (UBO) to the $950,500,000.00. I will employ the
services of an attorney who will immediately start handling the entire
documentations and who also will be responsible for the drafting and
notarization of the Affidavits which will eventually put you in place
as beneficiary of the funds.


The plan is that these documents will show that you are the true and
original ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) of the $950,500,000.00 which
was placed in time-deposit on your behalf under a “blind trust” since
2013; and that it should be rightly paid out to you immediately when
you request for it.


3.       Once these documents are ready, the attorney will take off
from there. She will make a personal appearance at the “”ICBC Global
Asset Management (Hong Kong) Limited”” to file for claims on your
behalf. These legally required documents will be presented by the
attorney to the ICBC bank requesting them to release the funds to you
immediately. The attorney will be acting in your capacity in absentia
and by a Power of Attorney duly signed by you. I will forward you the
exact draft copy of the POA which you will sign to empower her.


4.       After my attorney has submitted these “”legally required
documents”” to the ICBC Bank, the bank may request two (2) working
days to verify the claims which my attorney will present. Once the
claims and the documents have been verified, the bank will sign an
approval for the funds to be released in your favor.

5.       Because of the agreement I have with Mrs. Diezani
Alison-Madueke, the most important criteria to qualify you to join us
in this project is that I must make sure you have a history of
capacity – business/financial/experience to handle such a volume of
money and therefore must have a current personal net worth of not less
than $50,000 minimum. Meaning, you must be capable of handling this
volume of money.



6.       For your benefit of doubt, all the relevant and related
documents (including Proof-of-Funds) involved in this project will be
made available to you after we have both signed the draft copy of the
agreement.


As it seems, I have taken the time out to make a long explanation of
the entire project and everything concerning it. It has been carefully
thought out and well planned to succeed using previous experiences in
similar projects of the immediate past. I will advise again you take
time to read and understand the above (6) points carefully.



The information requested earlier will be used to draft the Project

and conditions therein. Also, your records will be used to prepare and
complete the entire documentations and affidavits needed to put you in

I look forward to hearing any further inquiries which you may have,

Please permit me to introduce myself. My name is John Monk. I earn a living in the oil industry as an independent Feasibility/Project Management Consultant to oil refineries and other oil industries in Southern African, East Africa and some parts of Asia. We are based in Johannesburg RSA. Our mandate includes identifying specific licensed crude oil export/ marketing firms and recommending these firms to the oil refineries for supply of crude oil to the refineries.

 On my desk is a mandate from one the refineries to arrange for crude oil purchase from Libya for up to 2,000,000 barrels on monthly bases for 12 calendar months.



 The essence of my reaching out to you is the fact that am in the process of building a middle man structure to mediate between the 2 parties involved before the contract is signed. You may be wondering why I cannot do it by myself right? The honest fact is that as a consultant to these oil refineries, we are not allowed to act as suppliers of crude oil to them as well, hence the reason I need a trustworthy person outside my work circle in order to maintain a discreet profile.



 I wish to extend this partnership to you my friend to build a middle man structure with you, while I work from the back to guide you. Our commission/brokerage as middle persons is between $2 - $3 per barrel as case may be. So if the target of 2M barrels is met monthly we stand to share $4M - $6M every month for a span of 12 months with possible extension.



 Worry less about the speedy sales as I have contacts within oil producing country's top officials for license of crude oil export/lifting to any firm I so present for this business. Therefore if you can be able to handle this transaction with honesty and integrity, you should come back to me immediately for more details.



 Your urgent response is highly needed

 Regards.

 John Monk

messages.subject: DETAILS
messages.body:
Dear Muriel, Thanks for your well received message. Your reply I believed is an indication that you are willing to be part of this business opportunity. Also this will not prevent you from doing your normal business as this project is on the side for making extra income as a legal crude oil license holder. As long as you are going to be sincere towards this project, we will have reasons to celebrate in the end. The business is completely legal and you have nothing to worry about. 
PLEASE READ THE DETAILS AND GET BACK TO ME 

You are to become a middleman/sales agent between the buyer and the National Oil Corporation of Libya (NOC). You will be corresponding between the NOC (seller) and (buyer) electronically from the comfort of your home. To set the ball rolling in this venture, the first step is for us to apply for the crude oil export and marketing license from the NOC. 

There are two ways through which you can apply for the license, one you can apply in your company name if you have a registered company or you can apply as an individual in your name. I will draft a license application letter for you to fill and send to the Licensing operations department of the NOC to apply for the license. You will type the license application letter into your official company letterhead paper (If you want to apply in your company name) and send the application directly to the licensing operations department of  NOC which is responsible for issuing crude oil sales licenses. I will direct you step by step from the process of acquiring the license to become the middleman to the process of selling your allocated product to the BUYER. 

I will link you up with one company which has intentions to buy 2 million barrels of Libyan crude on monthly bases for 1 year. (So the commissions are paid out every month throughout the duration of the 12month contract.)This implies that you will not have problems finding buyers. I will guide you to apply for the license and also guide you step by step in all your correspondence between NOC and the BUYER until the BUYER pays the NOC for the crude after which your commissions will be calculated and paid into your nominated receiving bank account. 

Getting this license will give you the legal authorization of the NOC to become their sales agent. Please be informed that getting this license is never a walk in the park because of the prospective nature of the commissions paid to license owners every month. The licenses are usually given to the families and relatives of the top government officials as they did not want people to benefit from such a lucrative venture. But I have someone in the ministry of oil and gas who will assist us in getting the license. I will guide you to apply for this license and once you obtain it, the new doors will open. So I will need you to confirm if you want to apply for the license in your company name or in your individual name though company name is preferable. Awaiting your reply to enable us to move towards applying for the license. Regards  John

messages.subject: More Details
messages.body:
Dear Ruthie,


Thank you for your response to my earlier email. I am Mr. Ahmad Shahriman
Mohd Shariff, an Executive Director, CIMB Bank Berhad Malaysia. Actually,
this is a personal deliberation meant for you alone, and not for your
company or anyone else. In case I've reached you via your company or
business email address, I humbly suggest you provide a private/personal
email address (if any) for future correspondence.

I'm sorry to have surprisingly reached you in this manner. I found your
information via the internet search engine, and decided to contact you to
partner with me in this transaction for both mutual and monetary benefit. I
came up with this idea following my official meeting with Bank Negara
Malaysia (Central Bank of Malaysia) and other Investment Banks in Kuala
Lumpur a couple of days ago.

This is about the Estate of a deceased client and an Investment Bank
Account placed under our management many years ago. However, then, I was
the Chief Director HSBC Amanah Malaysia Berhad, and still a Non Independent
Director till date.



I would respectfully request that you keep the contents of this letter to
yourself only and respect the confidential integrity of the information you
come by as a result of this confidential letter. I contact you
independently and yes, no one is informed of this communication.

In the year 2008, my late client came to our Bank to engage in business
discussions with our private banking division. He informed us that he had a
financial portfolio of $8 Million (Eight Million United States dollars)
which he wished to have us invest on his behalf. Based on my advice, we
spun the money around various opportunities and made attractive margins in
our first months of operation, the accrued profit and interest at this
point was over $1.8 million United States Dollars.

In mid-2010, he instructed that the principal sum ($8, Million) be
liquidated because he needed to make an urgent investment requiring cash
payments in Malaysia. We got in touch with a Foreign Specialist Bank in the
United States, the Standard Trust Fund Bank, who agreed to receive this
money for a fee and make cash available to him. However, Standard Trust
Fund Bank got in touch with us last year that this fund has not been
claimed. On further inquiries we found out that the client Mr. Yousef, as
he is generally addressed, was involved in an accident in Mainland China,
which means he died intestate without a Next of Kin or Beneficiary listed
in his account file.

I will communicate with my Bank (HSBC Amanah Malaysia Berhad) top
management board to exercise a due diligence process on this matter. Upon
verification and approval, which will be the details I make available to
HSBC Amanah Malaysia Berhad, the HSBC Amanah Malaysia Berhad will
instruct Standard
Trust Fund Bank in the United States to make payment to you (Me & You).

You may not necessarily need to know much or everything about Mr. Yousef
 as it’s not a vital factor to winning a probate, but you may have to know
a few vital pieces of information, I know this might be a bit heavy for you
but please trust me on this. For all your assistance and compliance, I
propose that we split the money in half (50% each). In the banking circle
this happens every time. The other option is that the money will revert
back to the state coffers (Government Account) if not claimed. Nobody is
getting hurt, this is a lifetime opportunity for us. I hold the key to
these funds, and as a Malay National with many years of service in the
banking sector, we see so much cash and funds being reassigned daily.

I would like us to keep the communication strictly confidential and only
communicate via your private email address. I also would like you not to
disclose this matter to anyone at the moment until the funds are
successfully conveyed out the shores of Malaysia. Please note, I am a
family man, I have a wife and children. I have my reputation and career to
protect and I wouldn't like to get myself in any ugly situation as well as
yourself. I send you this mail not without a measure of fear as to the
consequences, but I know within me that nothing ventured is nothing gained,
and that success and riches never come easy or on a platter of gold. This
is one truth I have learned from my private banking clients. Do not betray
my confidence.


If we can be of one goal, we should act swiftly on this and with utmost
secrecy. Please get back to me immediately via email and let me know if you
intend to assist or not. If you do not want to be involved, kindly let me
know so I would immediately sever further communication with you.

I will provide further details upon receipt of your confirmation email.
Thank you in anticipation of your response.
Thanks

Mr. Ahmad Shahriman M. Shariff.

Executive Director

CIMB  Bank

documents, I must respectfully decline at this stage. Providing those
details would effectively disclose all the information pertaining to the

understanding and commitment to proceed.

I am contacting you from South Africa, where I work with Investec Bank. You
may reach me directly at +27 82 433 5388 should you wish to discuss this
matter further.

I initially reached out to you in connection with an unresolved life
insurance cover that bears your last name. The insurance company involved
has made extensive efforts to locate any relatives of the deceased
policyholder, but unfortunately, those attempts have been unsuccessful. As
part of their due diligence, they contacted the bank where the deceased
held an account, which is how this matter came to my attention.

After reviewing the case, I also made every effort to trace surviving
relatives, but was unable to identify a definitive next of kin. As a final
step, I conducted a broader search for individuals sharing the same last
name as the deceased. Among several possibilities, my instincts strongly
guided me to your name.

While there is no certainty of a direct familial relationship, there
remains a possibility that you may be eligible to carry out the claim. If
you are open to proceeding, I am prepared to guide you through the
necessary steps to be recognized as the sole beneficiary.

To maintain confidentiality and ensure the integrity of this process, I
have withheld certain sensitive details for now. If you are interested in
pursuing this further, I encourage you to get in touch at your earliest

To move forward, I will engage a legal representative to assist in

Should you wish to proceed, please provide the following:

Please note that your physical presence will be required for the formal
filing of the release application.

I understand this may come as unexpected news, and I am available to answer
any questions or provide further clarification. Your cooperation is
appreciated as we work toward a successful resolution.

Warm regards,
*Anthony Richard*

Dear Mr James,

pharmaceutical company in the UK known as GSK Pharmaceutical Company.

carefully to have a clearer understanding.

someone to handle the contract and share the 60% with the person you are
bringing in to handle the contract with you.

regarding the raw material source and the end user procurement office
contact after I have a signed trust agreement MOU in place.
All details from my side including my official means of identification will
be provided once I am sure you are serious about doing business with me.
To clarify, this business involves the contract supply of raw materials
with the intention of earning legitimate profit. It is important to note
that as an employee of my current company, I am unable to act as a
contractor supplier to the same company..This is an open business venture
with no hidden agenda. Transparency is key, and you will have full
visibility into all aspects of the process as we move forward.The contract
involves the supply of Ginovera Mixture  Herbal powder raw materials to an
end user pharmaceutical company in the UK. Currently, the Existing supplier
OR Current Supplier is obtaining the raw materials from the original
Farmer/Producer in the USA, whom our company believes is the genuine
producer.

 The current supplier is providing the materials at a rate of $1300 per kg,
while the original producer in the USA is selling at less than $1000 per kg.

In order to make your price offer more competitive and attractive to secure
the contract opportunity, I suggest  to you or the competent trustworthy
person you are bringing in  to offer a lower price of $1,200 per kg to the
end user company. Once trust is established, the company will arrange
payment of 50% or 100% to you upon receipt of mandatory laboratory test
samples to assess the quality of your raw material product as a new
supplier.

It is worthy  to note that the  Ginovera Mixture Powder Herbal raw
materials  are used in the production of human fertility treatment and
sexually transmitted treatment medicine. As such, there is a high demand
for these materials, making this business venture potentially lucrative.
After careful consideration, I have chosen to seek out a trustworthy
individual to take on this supply contract. The selected individual will
have the opportunity to share in the profits generated from this business
venture.

This is why I have approached you with this opportunity.

After doing this contract for one year and half, I plan to resign from the
company as  a salary earner  to set up my business or we do a joint
business that is profitable in your country if you are so interested..Your
role as the new supplier will involve direct dealings with the farmer and
ensuring that the products are packaged or labeled under your company's
name before shipping to the end user pharmaceutical company as the current
supplier is doing to earn all the profit to himself alone.

To give you an idea of the profit potential, if you were to multiply your
$200 profit per sachet by 20,000 kgs, you would obtain the profit from the
first 20,000 sachets supplied to our company.As an incentive for your
involvement, we will share the profits on a ratio of 60% for you and 40%
for me, given that I have facilitated your access to this privileged
business opportunity.

It is important to act swiftly to secure this contract before other
suppliers emerge from alternative sources.If you are interested in
proceeding, I kindly request the following personal details in order to
draft a Trust/Profit Share Agreement
Once I receive the above details, I will send you a draft copy of the
Profit Share Agreement for your review. This will allow you to decide
whether you wish to proceed or not. The agreement will protect my interest
in offering you the opportunity to supply the product to the pharmaceutical
company.

If you choose to move forward, I will provide you with a draft sample of
the Supply Application Letter. This letter will need to be addressed to our
company and officially apply for the supply of the  Ginovera Mixture Powder
Herbal raw materials  .
Rest assured, this business venture will always be mutually beneficial as
long as there is a foundation of trust between us.
Please note that once the profit share Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) is
signed, I will provide you with direct contact details for the purchasing
department of the pharmaceutical company, as well as the farmer's contact
information. I will also supply you with a sample copy of the supplier
application letter to avoid any mistakes on your part.
I am willing to provide further explanations if you are still interested to
participate in this contract supply offer.
Thank you for considering this opportunity.
Regards,
Des.

Good day, Mrs. Peterson—

I’m a bit slow with computers, sorry. Could you please mail official paperwork on letterhead? I don’t share personal details by email or click anything from the sky locker. It’s blustery on the coast today and Sir Biscuit keeps mimicking the phone.

Kindly confirm your full office mailing address in London, a main switchboard number, and normal hours (I’m usually free around 4:30 a.m. your time). Also, what tax forms or fees, if any, would be involved? Those “SA NL / FISA” bits confuse me—could you spell out what they mean?

Once I receive printed documents, I can review them with a cup of tea.

What postal address should I use, and who should I attention it to?

Best wishes,
Eric

messages.subject: Re: Attention: Email Account Holder

and therefore must follow the rightful and legitimate processes.


Conclusively, please confirm if you would be physically available here in
the London United Kingdom  or United State Head office within Seven (7)

Until you respond and/or the statutory office confirm your prize

 Regards,

Tel: +447355840101
London, UK Zonal – Agency

Rose Peterson

messages.subject: Re: Attention: Email Account Holder
messages.body:
Hello Rose,
Thank you. I can’t travel to London or the U.S. within seven working days. Please handle this only by postal mail. Kindly send official documents (on letterhead, stamped) explaining the prize, any taxes/fees (exact amounts and who they’re paid to), and a plain-English note on “Proxy Legal Modality (PLM)” and any codes.

Please provide your London mailing address, main switchboard number, and office hours. I prefer very early calls—about 6:30 a.m. Eastern, if needed. No links or computer steps, please; I only review printed paperwork from the post.

Sorry if I’m slow—blustery here by the bay, and my parrot keeps chiming like a telephone. Once I receive the mailed packet, I’ll sit with a cup of tea and read it. When will you post it, and from which address?
Warmly, may I confirm your hours?

Best wishes,
Eric

messages.subject: Re: Attention: Email Account Holder
messages.body:
Good day Eric

Please email me your full Address for us to proceed.
Regards

Mrs. Rose Peterson

messages.subject: Re: Attention: Email Account Holder
messages.body:
Good day, Mrs. Peterson—

I believe you’ve mixed me up; I’m Mrs. Hart. For safety I don’t email my home address, and I’m handling this by post only.

Please send your physical London mailing address, your main switchboard number, and your earliest morning call window. I will ring the switchboard at opening time to provide my postal address verbally.

Kindly confirm you will then mail an official packet (on letterhead, stamped) that explains the prize, itemized taxes/fees, and a plain-English note about that PLM thing and the codes. No links or downloads, please, and I can’t travel.

Fog off the bay today, and my parrot keeps ringing like a phone—apologies if I’m slow. When can I expect your address details, and which day suits that early call?

Best wishes,
Eric

Joyce

messages.body:

Shipment Details:

Number of Packages: 2 metal trunk boxes

Weight: Approximately 65 kg each

Dimensions: W61 x H156 x D73 cm (effective capacity ~680 L)



Contents: Significant sum of money (estimated at $4 million or more per box) Status: Currently unclaimed due to incomplete declaration and unpaid inspection fees

The shipment remains in our custody pending proper verification. To proceed, please confirm the following information:



1. Full Name

2. Phone Number

3. Full Mailing Address



Upon verification, you may:



Physically attend our facility for self-verification and to claim the shipment, or Engage a licensed and secure shipping service to coordinate delivery to your preferred address



Important Notice:



The claim process is expected to take no more than seven (7) working days from receipt of your verified information.

After this period, any unclaimed shipment will be classified as abandoned and may be legally confiscated in accordance with state regulations.

We are committed to ensuring the secure handling and proper processing of your shipment. Please respond promptly to avoid delays or forfeiture.



Sincerely,



Mr.Henry Martins

Head of Inspection Unit

Jacksonville International Airport Florida

Phone:656-251-6316 / Whatsapp

messages.subject: Re: Immediate Verification Required – Unclaimed Shipment
messages.body:
Dear Martins,

I’m a bit confused. Is the shipment at JFK in New York or at an airport in Florida? Your note says both.

Who sent it, what’s inside, and what name is on the label? Do you have a tracking/airway bill number?

Why is it linked to me? Please paste the exact label text.

What’s your full office address, badge/ID, and a main switchboard number I can call later? Also the official website page for your unit.

Are there any fees or taxes? If so, list them and the step-by-step process to verify this without my sharing personal details yet.

When do the “seven working days” start—what exact date?

Also, “custody” sounds serious—was the box arrested?

Captain Biscuits is squawking and I need to water the tomatoes, so I can’t call now. Please resend your message in complete sentences. Thanks.

Best wishes,
Mary

messages.subject: Re: Immediate Verification Required – Unclaimed Shipment
messages.body:
*To * Mary *,*

This is to formally notify you that the delivery in question was
intercepted and placed on hold by the *Transportation Security
Administration (TSA)* due to non-compliance with TSA regulations,
specifically the absence of proper *declaration and registration* of the
shipment.

During the inspection process, the delivery expert responsible for the
consignment abandoned the trunk and other accompanying items and fled the
scene. Upon further security clearance and verification, your name, email
address, and phone number were discovered on the official delivery form,
thereby establishing your rightful claim to the consignment.

In accordance with TSA cargo handling regulations and U.S. federal
compliance procedures, no release or transfer of such consignment can be
authorized until the following requirements are satisfied:

   1. *Settlement of the TSA penalty fee* for undeclared cargo.
   2. *Payment of clearance charges* to enable lawful verification and
   procurement of a TSA-issued clearance certificate.

Only upon fulfillment of these obligations will you be legally entitled to
obtain the clearance permit, which authorizes you to take personal
possession of the consignment without any further restrictions or
liabilities.

For transparency and assurance, I will provide you with video evidence
documenting the discovery and inspection of the boxes, so that you can
personally verify the contents and condition of the consignment.

Please consider this matter of urgency, as the TSA requires compliance
within the regulatory timeframe. Failure to regularize the documentation
and clear the charges may result in permanent forfeiture of the consignment.

Respectfully,
*Mr. Henry MartiN*

messages.subject: Re: Immediate Verification Required – Unclaimed Shipment
messages.body:
Hello Mr. Henry (or Martins?),
You addressed “To Mary.” I’m Ruth. Please resend a complete, clear message—plain sentences, no links or attachments.

Which airport is it—JFK or somewhere in Florida? Exact terminal/office.
Who sent it? What’s inside, weight, trunk color, courier name? Tracking number?
Paste the full label/waybill text (name and address) into this email.

Exact fees in USD, itemized. Cite the TSA rule/regulation number. How do I pay only on an official .gov portal? No gift cards, wires, or couriers.

When did the “seven working days” start? Give calendar dates for deadline.
Your full name, title, agency, badge/ID, office address, official website, and a main switchboard I can call later to verify.

If you have “video,” paste a short description of what’s shown.

Captain Biscuits is squawking “Pay the penalty!” but I won’t until I can verify. I’ll be at the garden and church bake sale—can call the switchboard later.

Best wishes,
Mary

messages.subject: Re: Immediate Verification Required – Unclaimed Shipment
messages.body:
Dear Ruth,

The applicable processing fee remains USD $7,250.

You are expected to verify your details in order to confirm your ownership
of the consignment. Without this verification and the required settlement,
the trunks will be classified for confiscation and forfeiture within seven
(7) working days, commencing Thursday.

Please note that this consignment has been abandoned for a considerable
period of time, and during my review I located your email address on the
delivery form. That is the reason I have reached out to you personally.

If no claim is initiated within the stated period, the consignment will be
processed accordingly. For security and confidentiality reasons, I advise
that this correspondence be treated as strictly private.

Be further advised that the fee is not directed to any government account;
it is specifically designated for processing, verification, and the secured
release of the consignment.

Kindly give this matter your immediate attention.

Yours faithfully,
Mr. Henry Martin

messages.subject: Re: Immediate Verification Required – Unclaimed Shipment
messages.body:
Your note is missing words. Please answer clearly:

- What airport/city now? (Earlier you said JFK and Florida.)
- Who sent it and what’s inside?
- Tracking/air waybill number; exact name on the label.
- Why tied to me? How did my email get on a form?

Verify without my data:
- Your office street address, public switchboard, website, badge/ID. I’ll call later.
- Paste the label and any hold/fee notice into the email. No links/attachments.

Fees:
- Itemize each fee, amount, agency, and cite the regulation (CFR). If TSA, give section. Only pay on a .gov site—never to an individual.

Also, your last note said “To Mary.” I’m Ruth.
“Seven working days from Thursday”—what exact date?

Captain Biscuits is squawking; garden time now.

Best wishes,
Mary

years without a child, so I am childless and have no one to inherit my
husband's money when I am gone. I prayed to God asking him for direction on
who to donate the funds to before contacting you, and I want you to know
that I am not asking you for any money, rather I seek for your trust and
honesty in distributing the donation money to poor Children like
motherless, destitute homeless people. I have also donated to charity
organizations in Asia, Africa and South American countries, but this time I
want to donate the sum of, ( a total sum of $5.5 million USD) to you as an
individual to help distribute it to the homeless children and destitute
around you.

Recently, My health has deteriorated, and my doctors have informed me that
I have a few months to live, and as a result of shock, I was hit by a

will use this money to help the poor in the religious houses, orphanage

to you because I don’t have any child that will inherit this money, and
considering my ill health, I had no choice but to give the money out for
humanitarian projects.

I sincerely request for your assistance in this humanitarian work. I will
send a funds transfer request letter to my bank instructing them to
transfer the total sum of Five Million, Five Hundred Thousand Dollars into

United States Dollars for the humanitarian projects. The remaining One
Million United States Dollars will be for you as a reward for your good

I mentioned above to carry out the humanitarian project. Note that there
are no risks involved because my late husband acquired the money through
legal means, and the donations funds transfer process will be followed
legally.

Presently I am taking treatments at the Adventist specialist cancer

slowly. I write emails with the help of my assigned lady nurse here Ms.
Sandra Bullock. She is a trusted lady whom I have known in recent weeks,

I pray that God will give you more anointing and wisdom to handle this
project to the Glory of God. Amen.

Thanks and may God bless us all.
Best regards,
Mrs. Warnock Martha Lee.

messages.subject: Re: Business
messages.body:
Dear friend,



My name is Tom Raham I’m from Al Jahra’, State of Kuwait. I’m interested in investing in any good profitable yielding business and I would appreciate any viable ideas you could come up with. I’m proposing to invest the sum of Twenty Million United States Dollars ($20,000,000 USD) for this. I don’t know if you can be of help to me and trusted for this.



In recent times, I’ve been having issues with my uncle based on my late dad’s shares. I had to take every necessary precaution in order to sell off the shares without his notice and elope to any country. During my visit to Asia, I made enquirers on certain companies that usually help in the aspect of safekeeping investment funds and a specific company located in Malaysia known as Oceanwaves Security Company was the best option for me in terms of security and immunity aspect. I had to make a deposit to the company and I was given a mandate of 6months.





I had a call from the company days back in order to remind me of the fund deposit I made with their company as it is already 6months in which I and the company agreed upon for safe keeping. Considering the issues and contention with my uncle,I can’t travel to Malaysia in order to secure the fund I deposited with the company. I’ve been exempted from traveling until the issue I am having with my uncle is resolved.





Due to my present state
 I need your help in terms of traveling to Malaysia in order to secure the fund for me
. I spoke with the company days back seeking if it is possible for me to appoint someone to come secure the fund. Their response to me was positive and instructed that I should send a copy of the CERTIFICATE OF DEPOSIT, more details to whomever I appoint that will be responsible for the fund pickup. In doing this,I am willing to offer you 40% of any investment done with the fund.





All I need is your reliability in doing this and every further detail and contact of the company will be provided based on your determination in handling this. I’ll be expecting a response from you as soon as possible. Your cooperation in this regard will be highly appreciated.



Regards,

Tom Raham

messages.subject: Re: Business
messages.body:
Dear Tom,

Oh my, Twenty Million is quite a lot. I do things the long way. I can’t travel—my knee’s touchy—and Captain Crumbs hates airports. Could we use paper mail?

Please send, by post (no links):
- Oceanwaves Security Company’s full street address, phone number, license/registration, and a real contact name.
- A paper copy of the “OF DEPOSIT” (is that the receipt?) and the mandate.
- Your own mailing address.

Where did you get my email? Who pays for couriers? If I must call, is 5:10 a.m. your time alright, and what country code should I dial?

Best wishes,
Roselee

messages.subject: Re: Business
messages.body:
Dear Roselee,
Thank you for your email message and readiness to work with me in this venture.
I will like you to send me your complete details so we can make progress.
Tom Raham

messages.subject: Re: Business
messages.body:
Dear Tom, Thanks for your patience. I go slowly with money matters. Before any “details,” please send:

Oceanwaves Security Company full registered name and street address in Malaysia; landline with country code; Malaysian license/registration number and issuing authority; name/title of your contact there with direct number; their mailing address; and your postal address.

Please mail hard copies of the deposit certificate and mandate. After I verify, I’ll share my post office details. Also, where did you get my email? We could speak Tuesday at 6:10 am your time or 9:40 pm mine. Please write the number with the plus sign. Captain Crumbs is squawking. Can you post the proofs first?

Best wishes,
Roselee

Thanks for your email.
I will like you to send your complete address so I can send you the hard copy of the certificate of deposit of the fund.
Your friend,

messages.subject: Re: Business
messages.body:
Dear Tom,

Thanks for writing. Before I share any address, I must verify things, please.

Kindly send:

- Landline with country code

Roselee

messages.body:
Dear Mr. Cooper,
Thank you. I’m a bit slow, so please clarify.
You said “investment.” Is that equity? What percent, voting rights, and any repayment? Are there any upfront fees or notary charges? Collateral?
Kindly mail me a brochure and a one‑page form. I don’t use WhatsApp or links.

Kettle’s whistling and Captain Crumbs is squawking.

Best wishes,
Corey

messages.body:
Dear Sir/Madam



I hope this message finds you well. We are pleased to inform you of a significant opportunity available through a special insurance package issued by the current President of the United States, Donald Trump, valued at $55 million USD. This exclusive insurance offer has been made available to a select group of individuals, and we are contacting you regarding the process to claim and benefit from this substantial coverage.




In order to move forward with this opportunity, we kindly request that you provide the following credentials and information for verification purposes: Full Name, Date of Birth, 
Government-issued Identification Number
, Residential Address, Contact Information (Phone and Email),
 and any relevant details regarding your financial status or previous investments
. This information will allow us to proceed with ensuring the proper documentation is in place for the release of the funds.



Additionally, in order to facilitate the release and crediting of the insurance amount to your account, you will need to open an account with our partner, Elite Investment and Trading Company.
 This step is crucial for ensuring the transfer of the $50 million USD insurance payout to your designated account. The process is straightforward, and our team will be available to guide you through each step as needed.



We look forward to assisting you in securing this exclusive opportunity. Should you have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact us. Your prompt response will help expedite the process and ensure that all necessary steps are taken to benefit from this unique offer.



Best regards,

management.

Dear Sir or Madam,

How nice of you to write. I’m a bit confused though. What is the exact amount? Your note says “valued at million USD.”

Who is the actual insurer, please? May I have the policy number, issue date, your company’s full name, license/registration number, phone number, and a physical mailing address? An official letter on letterhead would help.

Best wishes,
Terry

Mijn oprechte excuses voor de vertraging in het beantwoorden van uw vraag. Vanwege het grote aantal lopende rechtszaken liep onze reactie onvermijdelijk vertraging op. Ik wil u echter verzekeren dat ons kantoor zowel competent als goed gepositioneerd is om u te helpen bij het oplossen van de kwestie van uw achtergelaten tegoeden, die momenteel door het Amerikaanse ministerie van Justitie in administratieve bewaring zijn geplaatst.



Toen ik vorige week op het districtskantoor van het Amerikaanse ministerie van Justitie in Houston verscheen ter vertegenwoordiging van een andere cliлnt in een soortgelijke zaak, stuitte ik op documentatie en documenten met uw naam erop. Deze documenten lagen op het bureau van rechter Gareth Bull, hoofd van de afdeling Geldafwikkeling. Na nadere bestudering en navraag werd bevestigd dat er tegoeden ter waarde van Ђ 5,2 miljoen op uw naam nog steeds niet zijn opgeлist en dat deze als achtergelaten zijn gecategoriseerd vanwege het niet naleven van de vereisten voor de afhandeling en procedurekosten.



Hoewel ik niet eerder door u als juridisch adviseur was ingeschakeld, voelde ik mij te goeder trouw en op grond van mijn professionele ethische plicht genoodzaakt u van de situatie op de hoogte te stellen. Deze kwestie is van ernstig juridisch belang en kan aanleiding geven tot frauduleuze claims, vooral omdat mij is meegedeeld dat verschillende derden hebben geprobeerd het eigendom van de genoemde gelden te claimen. Sommigen beweren – zonder verificatie – dat u overleden bent, naar verluidt als gevolg van de COVID-19-pandemie, en verklaren zich daardoor tot uw nabestaande.

Laat ik eerlijk zijn: de aanhoudende vertragingen en complicaties rond de vrijgave van uw gelden zijn het gevolg van herhaaldelijke verwaarlozing van juridische procedures en een gebrek aan officiлle juridische vertegenwoordiging. Talrijke cliлnten worden het slachtoffer van aanhoudende kostenclaims omdat ze vertrouwen op tussenpersonen die geen wettelijke bevoegdheid hebben, wat vaak leidt tot een voortdurende cyclus van eindeloze kosten zonder oplossing.



Ons juridisch voorstel

David Moore & Associates Law Firm is bereid u officieel te vertegenwoordigen en onmiddellijk stappen te ondernemen om:



Namens u de vereiste verklaringen te beлdigen en in te dienen.



Een aanvraag in te dienen voor wettelijke kwijtschelding van de kosten voor de afhandeling.

Verkrijg een bevel tot directe vrijlating van het Ministerie van Justitie op basis van de wettelijke bevoegdheid.



Deze procedure duurt, zodra deze is gestart, ongeveer 2-3 werkdagen. Daarna kunt u uw geld storten op een in de VS gevestigde rekening van uw gekozen bank, afhankelijk van uw voorkeur en juridische toegankelijkheid.



Juridische kosten en opdrachtvoorwaarden

Om deze procedure te starten, bedragen de totale kosten voor het opstellen en indienen van de aanvraag voor de verklaringen en afstand van recht Ђ 820,00. Ter ondersteuning van uw zaak is ons kantoor bereid Ђ 420,00 te subsidiлren en verzoeken wij u de resterende $ 400,00 bij te dragen. Dit zijn de enige vooruitbetalingen die van u worden verlangd.



Onze overeengekomen juridische kosten bedragen Ђ 10.750,00, te betalen na succesvolle ontvangst van uw geld. U bent niet verplicht dit uit eigen middelen te betalen; dit wordt verrekend met het teruggevorderde geld. Eventuele extra fooien of prestatiegerelateerde bonussen die u boven dit bedrag aanbiedt, zijn geheel naar eigen goeddunken. Onmiddellijke actie vereist

the following without delay:

Payment, Apple Gift Cards in denominations of $50 or $100, including

the same day. Please treat this matter with the seriousness it deserves, as
prolonged inaction may result in your funds being forfeited to the state

messages.body:
Dear Terry,

 Thank you for your response.
I appreciate your interest and will for my health, Since you are interested
in carrying my burden, I will proceed to let you know what to do, without
any hesitation. Let me enlighten you on what I want you to do for me. From
all indication, my condition has deteriorated and it is quite obvious
according to my doctors that I may not Leave for the next couple of weeks,
because my condition has gotten to a critical and life threatening stage
that is why I want you to handle the funds to reach the less privileged,
orphanages, single moms and widows in our society. I myself grew up in one
of the orphanages, that is why I so much want you to share my money with
the less privileged.

I was married to my late husband Engineer Carlos white. for twenty-two
years until his death on August 5th. Tragically he died on August   5th
night 2025 in a car accident alongside our only son ( Alex ) while they
were traveling to meet with me on my birthday which was supposed to be
August  12th. I will never forget that day when I felt the world has come
to an end but my Christian Faith with the help of my Pastor, I was able to
live again.

I am a fervent believer and a God-fearing woman just like my late husband.

messages.body:
Thank you for giving me your time. Let me start by introducing myself: I am
Mr. Bao Li Jie, an employee of WING HANG BANK here in HONG KONG.I contacted
you regarding a client and an investment placed under the management of our
bank; in fact, it was 4 years ago. I would like to ask you to keep the
content of this email confidential and also to respect the integrity of the
information you come across as a result of this email. I have contacted you
regardless of our investigation, and no one is informed of this notice; I
would like to share with you some facts that I believe may be of interest
to you. It is very important that you carefully read and understand every
word I wrote down below; please be patient and read the explanation in my
email.

In 2022, the subject, Ref.: HI/DSB/458/4 03/05 77, came to our bank to
conduct business discussions with our Private Banking Services department.
He told us that he had a financial portfolio of 11,500,000 euros (eleven
million five hundred thousand euros), which he wants to hand over (invest)
to us on his behalf. I was the official assigned to his case; I made
numerous proposals in line with my duties as de facto chief operations
officer of the Private Banking Services department, especially given the
amount of funds he wanted to invest in our bank.

A few months later, his attention was needed because of a business I wanted
to discuss with him, but I couldn't reach him. I made vain efforts to find
him. I immediately handed over the task of finding him to the internal
investigative department of our bank. Four days later, information began to
leak that he was apparently dead. A person who corresponded to his
description was declared dead in Cannes, southern France; soon, we were
able to gather more information, and the cause of death was confirmed.

The bank immediately launched an investigation into potential surviving
relatives to alert them to the situation and to report to claim its funds.
If you are familiar with private banking matters, the clients of our
services usually prefer anonymity, but also a certain distancing from
conventional processes. He did not list any next of kin in his personal
data sheet. In the field of private banking, opening an account with us
means that no one learns about its existence; accounts are rarely kept
under one name, and depositors use numbers and codes to anonymize the
accounts. This bank also gives depositors the choice of sending their mail
to them or keeping it with the bank itself to make sure there are no traces
of the account, and as I said, they rarely name the nearest relatives.
Apart from not naming private banking clients, in most cases, they also
leave wills in our care in most cases; he died without a will.

11,500,000 has been deposited. I alone have the deposit details, and they
will not pass the deposit on to anyone unless I instruct them to do so. In
addition, I know solely about the existence of this deposit, because as for
the financial firm, the transaction with our deceased client that was
completed when I sent the funds to the company, all outstanding
interactions regarding the file are only customer service and proper
procedure. The financial firm has no idea what the history or type of
deposit is; they are just waiting for instructions to release the deposit
to each party that comes forward, and this is the situation. This bank has
spent large sums to track down the deceased's family; they spent months
researching and didn't find a family, but the investigation has officially
ended.

My suggestion: I am ready and willing to put you in a position where the
financial firm is instructed to officially release the bail to you as the
closest surviving relative/employee, and all etiquette must be in
accordance with the rule of law. I can surely guarantee that. According to
customary law, the power of inheritance is concurrent with the first
beginnings of the law. No judgment prevents the legacy from being exhausted
by legacies that it becomes unworthy of its acceptance; impeccable process,
coordinating the paperwork to confirm your status as a sole beneficiary.
After receiving the deposit, I will share the money with you half and no
more; that is, I will simply name you as a relative and have the deposit
released to you; then we will share the proceeds 50/50.

I would have preceded to demand the release of the funds for me, but that
would have made me and my participation in the demand of the down payment
straightforward, but on the other hand, as an indifferent foreigner, you
would easily go through as a beneficiary to assert the rights, assure I'll
tell you that I could release you the bail in a few days. I will only
inform our bank of the completion of the customer file. If you are
interested in working with me, please contact me specifically. If you give
me positive signals, I will initiate this process towards a quick
completion.

It is necessary to inform you that under no circumstances should you
contact me through official channels; I will simply deny knowing you and
this project. I repeat, I don't want you to contact me through our official
lines, nor do I want you to contact me through my official email account. I
don't want a direct connection between you and me. My official lines are
not safe as they are regularly monitored to evaluate our level of customer
support in accordance with our Total Quality Management Policy. Please
follow these instructions diligently. Please note again that I am a family
man; I am married and have children. I don't send you this email without a
certain level of fear of the possible consequences, but I know within
myself that nothing dares, nothing is won, and that success and wealth
never come simply or on a tray of gold. This is the one truth I get from my
private banking clients. I learned: don't betray my trust. If we agree, I
will have the pleasure of meeting you, and plan a meeting after completing
this task.

I expect your answer.
Mr. Bao Li Jie.
