Dear sir/Madam,



I hope this message finds you well.



My name is Mr. Michael Rigas, Financial Secretary at the U.S. Department of the Treasury. During a recent audit of pending payment files, I identified a transaction in your name for the sum of USD $5.5 million, reference number UST/230/XX025. This payment has been duly approved by the U.S. Federal Government, with the U.S. Department Bank designated as the authorized paying institution.



While reviewing the file, I came across correspondence from Mr. Brian Morgan, who claims to be acting on your behalf. According to his submission, you have been diagnosed with a terminal illness (lung cancer) and are unable to personally oversee your financial affairs. He has therefore requested that the approved funds be transferred to him as your next of kin and business associate.



To protect your interests, I have placed a temporary hold on the processing of this payment until I receive direct confirmation from you. Please clarify at your earliest convenience:



Did you authorize Mr. Brian Morgan to act on your behalf regarding this payment?



If you are unaware of Mr. Morgan’s involvement, kindly notify me immediately. Upon your confirmation, arrangements can be made for the prompt release of your funds—either by visiting our office in person or by providing your designated receiving bank details.



For your security, please refrain from further communication with third parties concerning this payment. The U.S. Department Bank will not assume responsibility for any losses arising from unauthorized dealings or misdirection of funds.



I strongly urge you to treat this matter with urgency to avoid unnecessary delays. Should you require clarification or assistance, do not hesitate to contact me directly.



Sincerely,

Mr. Michael Rigas

Financial Secretary

U.S. Department of the Treasury

messages.subject: Invitation to Apply for €1,000,000 Philanthropic Grant from the Isabelle de Montclair Foundation.
messages.body:
Good day,

My name is Isabelle de Montclair, founder of the Isabelle de Montclair Foundation, a private European philanthropic initiative dedicated to supporting individuals and causes of exceptional purpose.



My foundation is offering financial gifts of €1,000,000 or more to individuals or groups who can demonstrate a profound need and a clear, impactful plan for how such funds will be used. This is not a contest or lottery,  it is a commitment to meaningful transformation.



If you believe your mission is worthy of such support, I invite you to formally express your interest by submitting the following information;



Initial Application Requirements

Your Full Name & Proposed Foundation or Mission Name

Example: Anna Rossi — Anna Rossi Foundation



Country of Residence (Europe only)



Brief Summary of Purpose (Max 100 words)

A clear, concise statement of what you aim to accomplish with the funds.



Detailed Proposal (Up to 200 words)

Please include:



The exact purpose and use of the funds (itemized if possible)



Expected impact and beneficiaries



Your capability or experience in executing this mission



Timeline or key milestones



Legal or Organisational Status

Individual, NGO, charity, company, or initiative (include registration, if applicable)



Promise of Responsible Use

Please include the following signed declaration:

“I, [Full Name], promise to use any funds awarded solely for the purpose described above and to remain accountable to the Isabelle de Montclair Foundation.”



Identification Document

A clear copy of a government-issued ID (passport, national ID card, or driver’s license) for identity verification only.

(No financial or bank details are required at this stage.)



Contact Information

Email, phone number, and city of residence.



Optional Supporting Documents

Budget plans, letters of support, project outlines, etc.



All submissions will be reviewed with utmost discretion. Those who meet our criteria will receive a formal reply and advancement to the approval stage.



I look forward to discovering extraordinary purposes deserving of extraordinary support.



Warm regards,

Isabelle de Montclair

Founder & Benefactor

The Isabelle de Montclair Foundation.

*Dear  Friend,I am writing to update you on an important development
regarding the funds we discussed previously and to solicit your active
participation in a critical phase of this venture.As you are aware, I have
shared with you the background of how the funds were acquired while I was
stationed in Syria. Briefly, these funds were discovered and subsequently
transported to Turkey through diplomatic channels, where they were secured
in a corporate vault. However, recent updates from the security firm that
previously managed these assets have brought about a significant change in
the process.The corporate security firm has informed me that they no longer
operate a physical vault for secure storage. Instead, they have
transitioned to online technology banking. Consequently, I have been
advised that I must now claim the funds from their transit deposit. Given
my current stationing in Ukraine, it is not feasible for me to handle this
transition effectively on my own.In light of this, I have informed the bank
of my intention to appoint you, my trusted business and investment partner,
to manage this process in my absence. They have stipulated that in order to
proceed, we need to draft a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) outlining our
investment partnership and have it signed by both parties. This MOU will
then be sent to them, allowing us to move forward with the necessary
account opening procedures.This is a crucial moment in our business venture
for several reasons:1. Secure Asset Retrieval: The transition from a
physical vault to online banking necessitates prompt action to ensure the
funds are securely claimed and managed. Delays could potentially jeopardize
our access to these assets.2. Strategic Advantage: By promptly engaging in
this process, we position ourselves advantageously to leverage the funds
for lucrative investment opportunities, thereby maximizing our returns.3.
Professional Partnership: The bank's requirement for a formal MOU
underscores the seriousness of this transaction and the need for a
professional, well-documented partnership. Your involvement in drafting and
signing this document is vital to maintaining the integrity and legal
standing of our venture.4. Operational Efficiency:As I am stationed abroad,
your role in this process is critical. Your active participation will
ensure that all procedural requirements are met without delays, and that
the funds are managed according to our agreed-upon strategy.I strongly
believe that your involvement in this stage will not only safeguard our
investment but also set a solid foundation for future business
opportunities. Your expertise and commitment will be invaluable in
navigating this transition smoothly and successfully.Please respond to this
message with the following details so that I can include them in the
MOU:Your full name Your physical addressYour occupationYour mobileScan the
front and back of your Identification ID This information is necessary
because the bank will open an account in your name to deposit the funds.
They will handle all required documentation to ensure the funds are legal
and to mitigate any risks.I need your absolute confidentiality and
commitment to this transaction. It should remain between us, as I trust you
completely. Your seriousness and cooperation are crucial.Upon receiving
this email, please confirm the details I’ve requested so that I can prepare
the MOU when I have access to a public computer. Thank
you.Respectively,Sincerely,Mark Kelvin Edwards(Sgt)1AD 1BCT G3,IRMO
Operations,US Army.PS: Find attachment, my Military ID for your perusal.*

messages.subject: Re: ASSIST REQUEST FROM YOU
messages.body:
Your email came through jumbled, and I can’t open attachments. Please type everything clearly, no links or files.

I will not send the front/back of any ID or open new accounts. That’s non‑negotiable.

Please provide:
- Exact amount (to the cent).
- Name and street address of the “security firm” and the bank. Where are the funds right now? What is a “transit deposit,” in plain English?
- Your unit, base in Ukraine, APO/FPO, commanding officer’s name/contact, and today’s local weather there.
- Your direct phone number and time zone. I might call later after I water the tomatoes.

Also, what does MOU mean? Paste the full text you want me to “sign” here, plus step‑by‑step instructions I can follow.

Why me, and how did you get my email?

Captain Biscuits keeps saying “trust but verify.” Seems wise.

Best wishes,
Brad

messages.subject: Hello
messages.body:
Hello,



Hope you are well. I want to connect you with a financier who can assist you in clearing any outstanding bills that are currently hindering the completion of your transaction.



Additionally, we will be able to provide you with an unsecured business loan up to $100M for investment. You will be able to secure the loan without collateral or security. The unsecured loan process is designed to be straightforward and transparent, often completing in a shorter time frame.



If you’d like to explore this further or you prefer having me come on board as an investor, feel free to let me know. I’d be happy to partner with you.



Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your response.



Mrs Helen Camara

messages.subject: Re: Hello
messages.body:
Hello Mrs. Camara,
Thanks for writing. Kettle’s whistling and Mr. Pickles is loud—quick questions:
- Which “business”? I’m a retired florist.
- Your company’s full name, physical mailing address, and state license?
- Exact APR, all fees, terms, and a payoff example on $10,000.
- “Unsecured” = no house—or teapots—as collateral, yes?
- Three client references (Illinois preferred) and BBB record?
Please mail a brochure and sample contract; I only use paper. Also send a landline; I’ll call about 6:30 a.m. Central—read the number slowly, twice. How did you get my email? Let’s do this the long way. I won’t click links.

Best wishes,
Steven

messages.subject: Hello Steve
messages.body:
Steve,

Many thanks for your email.

I do not know you in person but your transaction was brought to my
attention and I have a financial platform that are willing to take over
your transaction and release the funds to you.

Alternatively, I have an investor who is able to give you a loan from $5M
upwards.

The process for the loan is simple and straightforward. We do not require
any payment or fee from you upfront to process the loan. You are not
required to provide collateral to secure funding. However, your presence
will be required. There will be a face-to-face meeting held with you and
the lender's legal team before the funds are released to you.  During this
meeting, you will visit the bank to complete necessary paperwork for the
release of the loan amount, and you are free to attend this meeting with
your lawyer. The funds will be made available to you before your return if
you are approved.

Kindly let us know your willingness to move forward and if you are able to
travel so that we can finalize the details. Upon your agreement to move
forward, we will discuss the terms of the loan, including interest rates,
repayment schedules, and other relevant details.

While responding to this email, please provide your telephone number and
address if you wish to move forward.
Thanks

Mrs Helen Camara
